card.name: Amount or size words after a quantity
card.fires_on: Small words and marks right after a quantity or size, such as 'time' in '10 mL at a time', a closing parenthesis after a study size, or 'mL' or 'seconds' after a number.

modes.label: Per-dose phrasing
modes.description: Words completing how much is given per occasion, such as 'at a time' or 'at the conclusion'.
modes.example: The solution should be vigorously swished in the mouth (10 mL at a<< time>>) for several seconds and swallowed.

modes.label: Study size
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after the number of participants in a large trial.
modes.example: The Helsinki Heart Study was a large (n=4081<<)>> study of middle-aged men without a history

modes.label: Units after numbers
modes.description: A unit or space directly after a number in doses or durations.
modes.example: incremental doses of 3 mL to 5<< mL>> with sufficient time between doses to detect toxic
